newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto Stock Exchange to halt Bre-X on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Toronto Stock Exchange to halt Bre-X on Monday.

text.p: The Toronto Stock Exchange said on Sunday it will halt trading in common shares of Bre-X Minerals Ltd at the opening of trading on Monday.
"The trading halt will be imposed in light of the extremely negative report from Strathcona Minerals as announced by Bre-X on May 4," the Exchange said in a statement.
It said the decision was made with the agreement of the Alberta, Montreal and Nasdaq stock markets where Bre-X shares are also listed.
"The exchanges will review the contents of the report in detail prior to determining the duration of the halt," the statement said.
